command:
set +e
# spawn runs task commands under bash -e; set +e so a failure reaches the line that reports it (spawn#707).
export PATH=/opt/conda/bin:$PATH TMPDIR=/tmp HOME=/tmp
cd /tmp
mkdir -p out db
echo "e592faea3e307f01b40d92e402a1707cefbfdd3f2b8acae886dd487eea5c73de  k2_standard_08gb_20250402.tar.gz" > idx.sha256
sha256sum -c idx.sha256 || { echo "FAIL: the index tarball does not match its pin"; exit 1; }
T0=$(date +%s)
# One gunzip pass; only the read-length distributions leave the archive. The 8 GB hash is never written.
tar -xvzf k2_standard_08gb_20250402.tar.gz -C db --wildcards '*.kmer_distrib' > out/extracted.txt 2>&1
rc=$?
cat out/extracted.txt
echo "tar_rc $rc extract_s $(( $(date +%s) - T0 ))" | tee out/extract-time.txt
[ "$rc" = 0 ] || { echo "FAIL: tar exit $rc"; exit 1; }
find db -name '*.kmer_distrib' -exec mv {} out/ \;
for L in 100 150; do test -s out/database${L}mers.kmer_distrib || { echo "FAIL: no database${L}mers.kmer_distrib"; exit 1; }; done
cd out && sha256sum *.kmer_distrib > kmer_distrib.sha256 && ls -l *.kmer_distrib > sizes.txt && wc -l *.kmer_distrib > lines.txt
cat kmer_distrib.sha256 sizes.txt lines.txt
